name: _AppIntents_SwiftUI
summary: Explore _AppIntents_SwiftUI types and the APIs available through One's generated iOS bindings.

declarations.name: ShortcutsLink
declarations.comment:
A button that brings users to the current app's App Shortcuts page in the Shortcuts app.

You can create a button by calling the initializer with an additional closure,
which gets called whenever the button is tapped before opening the Shortcuts app.

    ShortcutsLink(action: handleTap)
        .shortcutsLinkStyle(.dark)

members.name: init
members.comment: Creates a link that launches Shortcuts and then executes the specified closure.

declarations.name: ShortcutsLinkStyle
declarations.comment:
The styles to apply to buttons you use to open your app's page in the Shortcuts app.

Specify a ``ShortcutsLinkStyle`` value when you add a ``ShortcutsUIButton``
or ``ShortcutsLink`` type to your interface. For the ``ShortcutsLink``
type, specify the style using the ``AppIntents/ShortcutsLink/shortcutsLinkStyle(_:)`` modifier.

members.name: darkOutline
members.comment: A button style that applies a dark background with light text along with a light outline.

members.name: lightOutline
members.comment: A button style that applies a light background with dark text along with a dark outline.

members.name: automaticOutline
members.comment: The default button style with an outline, based on the current color scheme.

members.name: dark
members.comment: A button style that applies a dark background with light text.

members.name: light
members.comment: A button style that applies a light background with dark text.

members.name: automatic
members.comment: The default button style, based on the current color scheme.

declarations.name: SiriTipView
declarations.comment:
A SwiftUI view that displays the phrase someone uses to invoke an App Shortcut.

Use a ``SiriTipView`` to display the spoken phrase for the intent
you specify. Include an instance of your intent when you create the
view, and bind the view to a Boolean to handle the view's presentation.
The following example shows how to configure a button for a reorder
intent and bind it to an `isVisible` variable.

```
SiriTipView(intent: ReorderIntent(), isVisible: $isVisible)
    .siriTipViewStyle(.dark)
```
Note that you must use the ``AppIntent`` in an ``AppShortcut``. Otherwise this will display an empty view.

declarations.name: SiriTipViewStyle
declarations.comment:
The styles to apply to the tip views you use to display spoken phrases.

Specify a ``SiriTipViewStyle`` value when you add a ``SiriTipUIView`` or ``SiriTipView`` type to your interface.
For the ``SiriTipView`` type, specify the style using the <doc://com.apple.documentation/documentation/swiftui/view/siritipviewstyle(_:)> modifier.
